objective: Starting from stock llama.cpp 9048bad8 and the official Muse Spark Open NVFP4 checkpoint, build the NVFP4 GGUF pack and the base engine E0, requantize the routed experts to Q2_K, port the profile-seeded expert weight cache onto E0 as candidate E1, and hand arms A (NVFP4 on E0), B (Q2 on E0) and C (Q2 on E1) to the lab to measure time to first token, decode rate and total request time against A. Work each node of contract muse-q2-ttft-v2 with its capsules; every output is checked by its capsule verifier and an independent reviewer before the next node starts.

constraints.model_execution: Every model load runs under a 96 GiB cgroup cap with no swap and -lm mmap, one heavy job at a time; conversion and requantization under 32 GiB.
